q: Where were you when the violin vanished, and did you notice anything about the lock?
answer: I was in the main hall rehearsing until 9:45 pm, then I entered the instrument room. I noticed the Stradivarius case was slightly open, and there was a faint scratch on the lock, suggesting it had been tampered with. That's when I became concerned.

q: Onde você estava durante o ensaio e quem mais estava no prédio?
answer: Eu estava varrendo o corredor, fazendo meu trabalho de zelador. O maestro Lorenzo e a estudante Maya Santos estavam presentes, creio que ensaiando. Eu só os vi de longe, não conversei com eles.
